project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Firebase backend, Cloudinary media, Capacitor mobile
build_system: Vite 5 with @vitejs/plugin-react-swc, npm package manager. Must source nvm first: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, setup in src/test/setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build and confirm no errors. 2. Run npm run test and confirm all tests pass. 3. Verify bundle chunks are reasonable sizes (no single chunk over 600KB).
environment_constraints: Open internet - npm installs work. Node.js available via nvm. No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: All changes committed to main branch. Firebase is primary backend - do not migrate away. UI is premium dark theme, mobile-first.
key_patterns: Pages in src/pages/, components in src/components/, hooks in src/hooks/, lib utilities in src/lib/. Firestore queries use firebase/firestore SDK (collection, query, where, orderBy, limit, getDocs, startAfter). Auth via src/contexts/AuthProvider.tsx. Toast notifications via sonner. Path alias @ maps to src/. Cloudinary uploads via src/lib/cloudinary.ts. Already has zod, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers as dependencies.
directory_structure: Root: vite.config.ts, index.html, package.json, tsconfig.json. src/pages/ - route pages. src/components/ - reusable components. src/lib/ - utilities (firebase.ts, cloudinary.ts, format.ts, utils.ts). src/hooks/ - custom hooks. src/contexts/ - React contexts (AuthProvider). src/services/ - business logic (interestEngine). src/integrations/ - external service clients. src/test/ - test setup.
